summary: Learn to build, test, and troubleshoot SharePoint cloud flows and approvals with Power Automate. Explore the five-day course and enquire.
lede: SharePoint automation covers how site owners, support staff, and process coordinators build cloud flows for list, document, and approval tasks. Learners practise selecting triggers, using SharePoint column data and conditions, routing approvals, and checking run history to troubleshoot common errors. They also consider connector availability and flow ownership, and document workflow requirements for deployment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who configure SharePoint workspaces or coordinate tasks that move through SharePoint lists, libraries, and approval steps. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical Power Automate skills for routine Microsoft 365 workflows.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint sites, lists, or document libraries is recommended. No programming or coding is required. For hands-on exercises, you need access to a Microsoft 365 environment with SharePoint and Power Automate enabled; available connectors and capabilities depend on your organization's licensing and settings.
